selected.sectionText:
#### 9. Hexagonal Architecture View

The system model should stay independent from concrete storage, transport,
executor, and UI choices.

Core model candidates, grouped by owning component:

```txt
Work Lifecycle Engine:
  Work
  Work identity/status/stage/claim/context/document state

Agent Coordination Engine:
  CoordinationSession
  AdhocTask
  Assignment
  Synthesis

Dispatch And Execution Engine:
  DispatchPlan
  Run

Run Result Evaluator:
  RunResult
  Evidence
  ArtifactRef

Domain Components And Extension Layer:
  FlowDefinition normalized model
  PolicyPatch
  TaskSpec / Skill references
  domain workflow definitions
```

This replaces the flatter mental model:

```txt
CoordinationSession
AdhocTask
Assignment
DispatchPlan
Run
RunResult
Evidence
Synthesis
PolicyPatch
FlowDefinition normalized model
```

Port candidates, grouped by owning component:

```txt
Work Lifecycle Engine:
  WorkLifecyclePort
  OccupancyPort

Agent Coordination Engine:
  SessionStorePort
  AssignmentStorePort
  TeamCognitionPort
  WorkContextPort

Dispatch And Execution Engine:
  DispatchResolverPort   (superseded in naming by DispatchRuntimePort,
                          [Component Authority Boundary Map §13](../architect/proposals/component-authority-boundary-map.md#13-draft-ports);
                          same candidate facade, not two live ports)
  RunStorePort
  ExecutorAdapterPort

Run Result Evaluator:
  EvidenceCollectorPort
  ResultNormalizerPort
  ArtifactStorePort

Domain Components And Extension Layer:
  DefinitionLoaderPort
  DomainHarnessPort
  ProtocolPackagePort
  PolicyProviderPort
  EvidencePolicyPort

Host And Surface Layer:
  VisibilityPort
  CommandSurfacePort
  ApiSurfacePort

Shared infrastructure:
  ClockPort
  IdGeneratorPort
  FilesystemPort
```

Adapter candidates:

```txt
YAML Workflow loader
Workflow definition loader
coding-domain harness
CLI spawn adapter
Herdr spawn adapter
MCP adapter
API adapter
local .fgos file store
Git evidence collector
test command evidence collector
Work engine verb adapter
```

This split makes replacement easier. For example, dispatch governance,
FlowDefinition validation, session DAG scheduling, Run supervision, or evidence
collection could move to Rust without requiring protocol packages or Skills to
move with them.

frameDefaults: { dispatches: 1, mutatingDispatches: 0, seatLaunchesPerDispatch: 4, fallbackPerSeat: 2 }

### 10.1 `core/workflows/council-lite.yaml`

**Trước** (47 dòng): một step `discussion`, một unit `deliberate` (`capability: delphi:propose`, `pattern: panel`, `blind: true`, ba roleTask panelist + synthesizer, contextRefs tới ba file posture). Vòng DAG chờ Unit, ghi `workflow.complete`. Thứ tự "ý kiến blind trước tổng hợp" nằm trong pattern panel; không gì trong run nói *vì sao*.

**Sau** (phác thảo):

```yaml
id: council-lite
kind: playbook            # mọi decision point listedRoutesOnly trừ khi điểm đó nói khác
milestones:
  - id: request-received   # subject: văn bản yêu cầu
  - id: positions-settled  # subject: ba report panelist
  - id: verdict-settled    # subject: report synthesizer
activities:
  - id: deliberate
    entry: [request-received]
    produces: [positions-settled, verdict-settled]
    unit:                  # giữ nguyên template hôm nay
      capability: delphi:propose
      pattern: panel
      blind: true
      contextRefs: [core/agents/council-assumptions.yaml, core/agents/council-ship-maintain.yaml, core/agents/council-feedback-loops.yaml]
      seats: [member-1, member-2, member-3, synthesizer]   # ghế khai tường minh, role producer ×3 + synthesizer ([seat-binding.md](../seat-binding/spec.md) mục 7.1)
      params: { roleTasks: { member-1: ..., member-2: ..., member-3: ..., synthesizer: ... } }   # khoá theo ghế
must:
  - id: independent-positions
    guard: independence-blind      # đóng gói một Unit panel với ghế blind là bắt buộc
    subject: positions-settled
    reason: một ghế đã đọc ý kiến ghế khác thì không còn là một lăng kính độc lập
closure: [verdict-settled]
frameDefaults: { dispatches: 1, mutatingDispatches: 0, seatLaunchesPerDispatch: 4, fallbackPerSeat: 2 }
```

**Một run sau thay đổi:** `workflow start council-lite` mở playbook case; Playbook proposer giữ `advance`, đề xuất `deliberate`; admission giữ 1 dispatch và trần 4 × 2 = 8 seat launch giao cho Unit; Execution Core chạy đúng Unit panel đó; settle ghi receipt, số launch đã dùng, `positions-settled` và `verdict-settled` achieved với digest report; close thành công; proposer nhả `advance`.

**Khác biệt quan sát được:** status hiện milestone kèm digest; run **không thể** tái tạo bằng ba `fgos run` tuần tự cộng lời thứ tư đọc chúng, vì `independence-blind` biến Unit panel đóng gói thành dạng duy nhất được admit; câu trả lời gate thứ hai không thay câu đã tiêu; khung từ chối dispatch ghi file. **Không đổi:** template, file posture, roleTask, ghế blind, start tách rời, cách giữ `advance`, ý nghĩa tám run đã lưu.

kind: playbook            # mọi decision point listedRoutesOnly trừ khi điểm đó nói khác
milestones:
  - id: request-received   # subject: văn bản yêu cầu
  - id: positions-settled  # subject: ba report panelist
  - id: verdict-settled    # subject: report synthesizer
activities:
  - id: deliberate
    entry: [request-received]
    produces: [positions-settled, verdict-settled]
    unit:                  # giữ nguyên template hôm nay
      capability: delphi:propose
      pattern: panel
      blind: true
      contextRefs: [core/agents/council-assumptions.yaml, core/agents/council-ship-maintain.yaml, core/agents/council-feedback-loops.yaml]
      seats: [member-1, member-2, member-3, synthesizer]   # ghế khai tường minh, role producer ×3 + synthesizer ([seat-binding.md](seat-binding.md) mục 7.1)
      params: { roleTasks: { member-1: ..., member-2: ..., member-3: ..., synthesizer: ... } }   # khoá theo ghế
must:
  - id: independent-positions
    guard: independence-blind      # đóng gói một Unit panel với ghế blind là bắt buộc
    subject: positions-settled
    reason: một ghế đã đọc ý kiến ghế khác thì không còn là một lăng kính độc lập
closure: [verdict-settled]
frameDefaults: { dispatches: 1, mutatingDispatches: 0, seatLaunchesPerDispatch: 4, fallbackPerSeat: 2 }
```

selected.sectionText:
#### 9. Hexagonal Architecture View

The system model should stay independent from concrete storage, transport,
executor, and UI choices.

Core model candidates, grouped by owning component:

```txt
Work Lifecycle Engine:
  Work
  Work identity/status/stage/claim/context/document state

Agent Coordination Engine:
  CoordinationSession
  AdhocTask
  Assignment
  Synthesis

Dispatch And Execution Engine:
  DispatchPlan
  Run

Run Result Evaluator:
  RunResult
  Evidence
  ArtifactRef

Domain Components And Extension Layer:
  FlowDefinition normalized model
  PolicyPatch
  TaskSpec / Skill references
  domain workflow definitions
```

This replaces the flatter mental model:

```txt
CoordinationSession
AdhocTask
Assignment
DispatchPlan
Run
RunResult
Evidence
Synthesis
PolicyPatch
FlowDefinition normalized model
```

Port candidates, grouped by owning component:

```txt
Work Lifecycle Engine:
  WorkLifecyclePort
  OccupancyPort

Agent Coordination Engine:
  SessionStorePort
  AssignmentStorePort
  TeamCognitionPort
  WorkContextPort

Dispatch And Execution Engine:
  DispatchResolverPort   (superseded in naming by DispatchRuntimePort,
                          [Component Authority Boundary Map §13](../architect/proposals/component-authority-boundary-map.md#13-draft-ports);
                          same candidate facade, not two live ports)
  RunStorePort
  ExecutorAdapterPort

Run Result Evaluator:
  EvidenceCollectorPort
  ResultNormalizerPort
  ArtifactStorePort

Domain Components And Extension Layer:
  DefinitionLoaderPort
  DomainHarnessPort
  ProtocolPackagePort
  PolicyProviderPort
  EvidencePolicyPort

Host And Surface Layer:
  VisibilityPort
  CommandSurfacePort
  ApiSurfacePort

Shared infrastructure:
  ClockPort
  IdGeneratorPort
  FilesystemPort
```

Adapter candidates:

```txt
YAML Workflow loader
Workflow definition loader
coding-domain harness
CLI spawn adapter
Herdr spawn adapter
MCP adapter
API adapter
local .fgos file store
Git evidence collector
test command evidence collector
Work engine verb adapter
```

This split makes replacement easier. For example, dispatch governance,
FlowDefinition validation, session DAG scheduling, Run supervision, or evidence
collection could move to Rust without requiring protocol packages or Skills to
move with them.
